# Phase 2 baselines (generated by experiments/run_baselines.py)

1443 perturbations (1275 genes, 168 drugs), 11 symptoms, relation induces. Grouped split: 5-fold cross-validation with leakage groups by gene (1344 groups); out-of-fold predictions pooled. Unobserved pairs count as negatives (positive-unlabelled convention). Pooled metrics are computed on the pooled out-of-fold predictions; per-fold values are the mean and standard deviation over folds of the macro metric, which is immune to the base-rate artifact that pulls pooled AUROC of a constant-per-fold predictor below 0.5.

## Pathway-wise split, curated modules (each module of design section 3.2 held out in turn)

Per-symptom AUPRC inside one held-out module is not meaningful (sets of 4 to 8 genes with homogeneous symptom profiles), so only pooled per-symptom metrics and per-hold-out ranking metrics are shown.
 Raw pooled scores across hold-outs with different base rates carry the artifact of section 6.2 (review v0.4, finding 1); the rank-within-hold-out columns replace each score by its tie-averaged rank over (n + 1) inside its hold-out before pooling, and the stratified AUROC forms positive-negative pairs inside hold-outs only. The pathway-wise endpoint is defined on the rank-within-hold-out macro AUPRC.

Held out (perturbations, positive pairs): catecholamine (22, 128); serotonin_melatonin (14, 98); tetrahydrobiopterin (5, 13); gaba_glutamate (6, 27); urea_cycle (8, 22); heme_porphyrin (4, 19); sterol_lysosomal_lipid (9, 26); creatine_energy (6, 10); acetylcholine_histamine_adenosine (6, 34).

## Pathway-wise split, Human-GEM subsystems (every gene whose primary subsystem is the held-out one)

Subsystems are the reconstruction's own pathway partition; they cover many more annotated genes than the curated modules and are the candidate definition of the pre-registered pathway-wise split.
 Raw pooled scores across hold-outs with different base rates carry the artifact of section 6.2 (review v0.4, finding 1); the rank-within-hold-out columns replace each score by its tie-averaged rank over (n + 1) inside its hold-out before pooling, and the stratified AUROC forms positive-negative pairs inside hold-outs only. The pathway-wise endpoint is defined on the rank-within-hold-out macro AUPRC.

Held out (perturbations, positive pairs): Alanine, aspartate and glutamate metabolism (8, 20); Arginine and proline metabolism (9, 19); Bile acid biosynthesis (5, 11); Biopterin metabolism (7, 16); Cysteine and methionine metabolism (8, 22); Glycerophospholipid metabolism (9, 31); Inositol phosphate metabolism (16, 36); Keratan sulfate degradation (6, 12); Leukotriene metabolism (7, 16); Lysine metabolism (12, 29); N-glycan metabolism (11, 15); Nucleotide metabolism (19, 55); Omega-3 fatty acid metabolism (4, 15); Oxidative phosphorylation (18, 38); Phenylalanine, tyrosine and tryptophan biosynthesis (19, 97); Porphyrin metabolism (8, 24); Purine metabolism (9, 28); Sphingolipid metabolism (11, 22); Sulfur metabolism (3, 10); Tricarboxylic acid cycle and glyoxylate/dicarboxylate metabolism (5, 17); Valine, leucine, and isoleucine metabolism (4, 14).

## Time split, monogenic pairs by availability date (cutoff 2015-12-31)

Training positives: 539 pairs dated on or before the cutoff; new positives: 565 pairs dated after it; undated (Orphanet-only) positives excluded: 2223; scored pairs: 13111 (every pair that is neither a training positive nor an undated positive). A pair's date is the publication date of the PubMed reference cited by its OMIM annotation (docs/hpo_reference_publication_dates.json) or, for annotations citing only the OMIM entry, the HPO biocuration date, so this split measures prediction of links published later. Permuted: new-positive labels permuted among the scored pairs of each symptom.
